certificate.caveat: When installed, initialized, and configured as specified in Section 11 of the Security Policy. No operator authentication is enforced for executing security services that were unlocked by an authenticated service
certificate.description: The Module is a PCIe Gen-4 x4 dual-port NVMe SSD that supports TCG Opal SSC v2.01. This SSD is a non-volatile, low latency, high-performance storage device intended for cloud, hyper-scale, enterprise data centers and computing environments. This SED device comes in a U.3 form factor physical enclosure.
